coverage.note: All 67 VBM county originals and all 35 required early-voting county originals verified for October 21. The other 32 counties had not opened early voting for the prior reporting day. All county-party totals reconcile to the 8:05 AM official compilation. No prior voter records substituted. Changes compare October 20 at 11:01 AM to October 21 at 8:05 AM (21 hours 4 minutes), not votes cast that day. Registration party is not candidate choice.

definitions.provided: VoteByMail status P (provided, not yet returned).
definitions.returnRate: Returned divided by sent/provided universe (V ÷ (P + V)).
definitions.early: Reported early in-person ballots from the separate EVL archive
definitions.cast: VBM returned plus early in-person ballots; zero cross-method duplicate returned voters verified
